channel.title: Sergey Yurkevich's blog
channel.description: Short notes on AI models, tools and research worth knowing about.

item.title: Tencent's Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0 does text-to-3D, editing and understanding in one model
item.description: Tencent published Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0 on August 3: text-to-3D, part-level editing and 3D understanding in one model, trained on 87M samples. Weights are not out.

item.title: nyra labs releases CrisperWhisper 2.0, a 2B verbatim speech recognition model
item.description: CrisperWhisper 2.0 scores 87.8 disfluency F1 across 10 languages, ahead of ElevenLabs Scribe v2 and Microsoft, and the weights download and run offline for free.

item.title: Eyeline Labs and Netflix release ID-V2V for identity-preserving video restyling
item.description: ID-V2V restyles a video's background and lighting from a single edited keyframe while holding faces, expressions and lip sync fixed. Weights and ComfyUI support are out.

item.title: OpenAI's unreleased Astra model produces ten results on open math problems
item.description: OpenAI published ten proofs on long-open math and TCS problems today, produced by its unreleased Astra model, each shipped with a Lean 4 formalization.

item.title: HKUST's HOMIE puts specific people and objects into generated video
item.description: HOMIE personalizes video with reference humans, products and logos, builds on the open Wan2.1-14B and Wan2.2-14B models, and ships code and weights.

item.title: Microsoft releases Mage-Flow, a 4B image generation and editing model
item.description: Mage-Flow generates and edits images at native resolution, handles depth and segmentation, scores 0.90 on GenEval, and ships open under MIT.

item.title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5, beating Fable 5 on most benchmarks at half the price
item.description: Claude Opus 5 shipped July 24, 2026. It outscores Fable 5 on most benchmarks at half the input price, though Fable stays ahead on SWE-bench Pro.

item.title: Nvidia releases ARDY, an open real-time text-to-motion model
item.description: ARDY generates 3D human and humanoid motion from text in real time; code is Apache 2.0 and weights are open, which could help generate synthetic motion data.

item.title: Claude Fable produces a counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture
item.description: On July 19, 2026, Levent Alpöge announced a Claude Fable counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture: a map with constant Jacobian determinant -2 and no inverse.

item.title: Demis Hassabis proposes a FINRA-style body to regulate frontier AI
item.description: In a July 14 manifesto Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis called for a US-led, industry-funded AI standards body that could vet frontier models before release and even pause the industry.

item.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model
item.description: Kimi K3 is the largest open-weight model so far, scores near Fable 5 on the Intelligence Index, and tops the blind-voted Frontend Code arena.
